record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README and a partial file listing only; code was not read or run. The README does not provide the detailed paper results.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports that category-specific refusal directions are geometrically distinct and describes shared and category-specific SAE components, refining the single-direction account. It also reports steering outcomes, but gives no detailed ablation results.
record.gate_note: The README reports qualitative findings about distinct directions, steering trade-offs and SAE latents. Script names, bundled directions and data descriptions are not evidence that listed ablations or other experiments ran or produced particular results.
record.test_reason: The README summarises the paper's own results. Difference-of-means refusal directions estimated separately for 11 refusal and non-compliance categories are geometrically distinct, yet each steers to a similar refusal/over-refusal trade-off. SAEs show a shared core of refusal latents plus category-specific tails. This argues for restating the single-direction account (V1) toward a multi-component one (V4). All evidence is qualitative: the README gives no numbers.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The authors conclude that refusal involves multiple geometrically distinct category directions, yet these are functionally near-interchangeable in steering because they share a core of refusal latents with category-specific tails.
record.recipe_differences: Research code-and-data repository for the paper, not identified as a replication. The README says it estimates separate category-specific directions and steers along them, but does not give enough method detail to establish an exact match to the original intervention.
record.peer_reviewed: not stated; README describes an EMNLP 2026 paper, while repository metadata calls it an ACL ARR 2026 submission
record.problems: The README provides only qualitative summaries, with no numerical outcomes, uncertainty estimates, control results, or per-model breakdown. The repository's code was not read or run, and the README notes that fourteen scripts need path adjustments.
record.rows_left_out: No further result rows extracted: script names and file listings do not establish experimental outcomes. In particular, the README's script references to ablation do not state ablation results.

untested.parts: Ablation removing refusal and preservation of other abilities. The README lists ablation tables (Table 2, App. J) but reports no outcomes.
Affine or cone formulations are not examined; how dominant the shared core is goes unquantified in the README.

No cross-language, cross-model or base-to-instruct transfer results. A script named results_llama_on_gemma exists, but no outcome is stated.

record.verdict_notes: Only the README and file listing were read; the paper's tables are not in the text. All verdicts rest on one qualitative summary paragraph and should be revisited once the paper (EMNLP 2026 / ACL ARR 2026) is read. The README header describes it as an EMNLP 2026 paper, while the repository description calls it an ACL ARR 2026 submission, so peer-review status is unclear.

versions.untested_parts: The README does not report whether removing one direction eliminates refusal, whether ablation at every layer and position works, or whether general abilities are preserved. It reports no quantified intervention outcomes.
No reported weight edit or abliteration outcome.
No reported attack suppression of a direction or training against its ablation.
The README does not establish an affine or cone representation, or quantify whether a dominant direction has additional components.
No reported separation of harmfulness judgment from refusal decision.
No reported cross-language or base-to-instruct transfer test.
No reported comparison of how or when refusal training creates directions.
